exposure: Newborn weight of 4,000 g or more
outcome: Maternal complications (preeclampsia, indicated preterm labor, premature rupture of membranes)
cohort: 2,012 pregnant women (1,006 with diabetes and 1,006 without) who labored at Phatthalung Hospital between 2017 and 2021
finding: Pregnancy-induced hypertension and newborn weight of 4,000 g or more were significant risk factors for cesarean section among diabetic pregnancies.
birth_weight: Measured, with newborns weighing 4,000 g or more increasing risk of cesarean section in diabetic pregnancies
